about_the_game:
CONDEMNED: Nightfall is a refreshing and dark take on the extraction shooter. Set in retro environments, including a Noir Futuristic New York City and an Ancient Egyptian village, terrifying creatures have overtaken a once-beautiful cityscape. Complete objectives, rituals for mystical special abilities and hunt down sinister Bounties that offer coveted Blood Diamond rewards should you successfully extract. But be warned- Its every man, or team, for themselves... And you aren't the only team trying to take back the 'City. Hunt or Be Hunted!

ABOUT THE GAME:

  • TWO unique game modes to choose from: HUNT Mode or Classic Survival Mode.

    • HUNT is a PvPvE Extraction Survival mode featuring rituals, special unlockable abilities, coveted boss bounty rewards and permadeath, meaning survival will not be easy. Once players level-up their hunter to their highest level, they can compete in competitive Hunts for ultimate bragging rights.

    • Classic Survival mode gives players the nostalgic, round-based survival mode that has been missing in the genre in recent years. Team up with two friends, or go in alone, and survive hordes of the undead as long as you can.

  • TWO gorgeous and vast open-world maps at launch: a retro New York City map and an ancient Egyptian Pyramid Village, the origin of the dark and terrifying outbreak of evil. Both maps offer beautiful landscapes and tactical gameplay opportunities that create the most intense competitive exchanges, between the undead and other teams of Hunters.

LOADOUTS:

Players will have access to selectable loadouts in both modes, giving players and teams a dynamic strategy when playing. While longer ranged sniper may prove excellent keeping fellow Hunters away, you might need a strong shotgun class to stay safe from the Berserkers that lurk around the map...

SPECIAL ABILITIES:

CONDEMNED: Nightfall features a Ritual system in which players in-game can unlock and customize a selection of OVER A DOZEN Special Abilities to give themselves and their team the ultimate advantage in the Hunt. Abilities range from insane insta-kills to temporary protection, from healing to increasing continuous damage. The Ancient Egyptian Village map serves as a lore-building origin to this system.

CHARACTERS:

CONDEMNED: Nightfall will launch with an expanding roster of playable characters. Each character will have a slightly customizable look, allowing teams to have a unique combination in-game.

content_descriptors.notes:
Blood VFX CAN be turned off in settings.

Depicts player(s) shooting, killing other players and horror-themed enemies.

Depicts use of forms of 'medicine' to heal, revive or cure player(s).

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel CPU 7th Gen 7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 Super or AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT, Minimum 4GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 56 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible audio card
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Spatial Audio Headphones
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel CPU 8th Gen 8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 Super / AMD 6600 XT, Minimum 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 56 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible audio card
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Spatial Audio Headphones

short_description: A survival horror PvE and PvP set in a Noir Futuristic NYC! Team up with up to two others, or go in alone, and search creature-filled semi open-world map for arcane clues that lead you to a lucrative Bounty. Featuring permadeath consequences, only the best hunters will make it out alive..
